name: Gravity Flip
description: On a quiet street, down becomes up and everything falls toward the sky while the subject holds on.

wardrobe.man: a long beige coat, a scarf and dark trousers
wardrobe.woman: a long beige coat, a scarf and dark trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands on the sidewalk of a quiet tree-lined residential street on an autumn afternoon, one hand resting on a black iron lamppost, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}. Fallen orange leaves cover the ground, a bicycle leans on a railing, trash bins and a bench line the sidewalk, and brick townhouses run along the street. Medium-wide shot at eye level, the {subject} on the left third with the lamppost, the street and the sky open on the right. Cinematic photography, soft overcast autumn light, warm orange and teal tones. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain brick facades throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands holding the lamppost, eyes on a point just past the camera. Gravity flips: the fallen leaves lift off the ground and fall upward into the sky, then the bicycle, the bins and a bench tumble upward and away, water from a puddle rises in drops, while the {subject} grips the lamppost with both hands, {their} feet lifting off the sidewalk, the coat, the scarf and the hair streaming straight upward. The camera tilts up slowly to follow the falling objects into the sky. Sound: a rushing upward wind, metal clattering and tumbling, leaves rustling, a creaking lamppost. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, inverted gravity physics with real weight and tumble, sharp detail, stable picture.
